trajectory_cell_feasibility.conclusion: Feasible as isolated geometry Definition subclass; not implemented or physics-qualified.
trajectory_cell_feasibility.body: Keep original ModuleMovingPlatform AnimatableBody2D unchanged; only supply position from Definition.at_time.

methods.is_valid: Require>=3 distinct finite vertices + exact duplicate final first, positive segment lengths, positive period, size/phase valid; base start!=finish/dwell>0 is unsuitable for a closed loop, override explicitly.
methods.period: Return one full-loop duration, matching model.progressAt loop; not base2*(travel+dwell).
